/v1/holds.customer_notice:
Dear M3 General Store (mule),

Sangam Urban Co-operative Bank, a co-operative bank has placed a temporary hold on debits of ₹2,15,000 from your account ending 3002, from 26 October 2026. The bank has done this under the Reserve Bank of India's directions on suspected money mule accounts, because of these transactions: Credits of ₹2,50,000 arrived in the 30 days to 26 Oct 2026, 01:48 AM IST, and that is 5.0 times the declared monthly income or turnover of ₹50,000 (₹6,00,000 a year). ₹2,50,000 arrived on 26 Oct 2026, 01:48 AM IST, and 80% of it left the account within 2 minutes in 1 debit.

You can still receive money, and you can use any balance that is not on hold.

To have the hold removed, send the bank an explanation of these transactions, with any documents that support it, such as invoices, agreements or salary slips, by 15 November 2026. The bank will decide within 10 days of receiving your explanation. If no explanation reaches the bank, it will decide by 25 November 2026, and it may then report the transactions to the police through the National Cybercrime Reporting Portal.

Contact: Fraud Risk desk, 1800 000 0000, or frm@bank.example
